summary: Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc., depositor for BANK 2019-BNK23, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that effective September 21, 2026, Argentic Services Company LP replaced Situs Holdings, LLC as special servicer for the ILPT Industrial Portfolio mortgage loan and related pari passu and/or subordinate notes, a non-serviced loan combination governed by the MSC 2019-L3 pooling and servicing agreement. ASC was appointed at the direction of Blue Owl Real Estate Debt Advisors LLC, the directing certificateholder. Servicing continues under the existing PSA. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are stated; this is a routine CMBS servicing change, not a special situation.
